preconditions.expression: n >= 1 and m >= 0 and all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in enemy_pairs)
preconditions.description: Input consists of n horses (1 ≤ n) and m enemy pairs (0 ≤ m), where each pair (a, b) represents enemies with 1 ≤ a, b ≤ n and a ≠ b.
Enemy pairs are unique and exactly m in number.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(enemies)) <= 3 for enemies in [set((a, b) for a, b in enemy_pairs if a == i) | set((b, a) for a, b in enemy_pairs if b == i) for i in range(1, n + 1)])
preconditions.description: Each horse has at most 3 enemies.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout) == n and all(c in '01' for c in stdout))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' (no valid split) or a string of length n with characters '0' or '1' representing party assignments.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' and all(any(c != d for c, d in zip(stdout, stdout[i:])) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If a valid split exists, the output string assigns each horse to party '0' or '1' such that no horse has more than one enemy in its own party.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(len([e for e in enemies if stdout[e - 1] == stdout[i - 1]]) <= 1 for i in range(1, n + 1) for enemies in [set((a, b) for a, b in enemy_pairs if a == i) | set((b, a) for a, b in enemy_pairs if b == i)])
postconditions.description: For every horse, the number of enemies in the same party is at most 1.
